purpose: Camera-angle revisions of the four student illustrations. The teacher illustration is unchanged. Fictional editorial artwork, not documentary photographs.

His face should NOT be visible. Overhead composition of the laptop at the upper right, small wooden wheeled cart in the middle, notebook and pencil at left. Include a little terracotta rug and attic wood floor around the desk to preserve room identity. Strong graphic overhead arrangement, not a tilted elevated three-quarter view.
